summary: Parameters of the comment filter: style (plain, decoration, erlang, c, cblock, xml), plus beginning, end, decoration, newline, prefix, postfix and their counts.
questions: What comment styles does the comment filter support?
How do I produce a C-style comment block from a string?
How do I customize the prefix of each comment line?

answer_card.title: comment filter parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `style` (default `plain`): `plain`, `decoration`, `erlang`, `c`, `cblock`, `xml`
- `beginning` / `end`: start/end of a comment block (multiline styles)
- `decoration`: comment or intermediate indicator
- `prefix` / `postfix`: tokens at start/end of each line, with `prefix_count` / `postfix_count` (default 1)
- `newline` (default `\n`)
